newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Erbakan accused of power abuse on haj.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Erbakan accused of power abuse on haj.

text.p: A Turkish woman has petitioned a prosecutor to put Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan on trial for allegedly abusing his position on a Moslem haj pilrimage to Mecca, Anatolian news agency said on Tuesday.
It said the woman, described only as Gulay Baytas, had accused Erbakan of using government resources to fund the trip in April. It was his 25th haj pilgrimage.
There was no immediate comment from Erbakan on the filing of the petition.
Erbakan, the first Islamist to lead secularist Turkey, flew to Saudia Arabia on a Turkish Airlines jet accompanied by around 25 relatives and friends.

The well-publicised haj trip angered Turkish secularists. Erbakan, under pressure from the secularist army, said at the weekend he would hand over power this month to coalition partner Tansu Ciller who is to take the country to early polls.
